definitions: To decide or announce that a planned event will not take place.
To stop a service or arrangement.
To invalidate or annul (a stamp, ticket, or cheque) with a mark or perforation.
To neutralize or counteract the effect or force of (something).
examples: They had to cancel the meeting.
I want to cancel my subscription.
The post office will cancel the stamps.
The two forces cancel each other out.
